description: Defines the WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool class, which manages WebSocket client sockets, including request handling, socket pooling, and connection management within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool
classes.description: Manages WebSocket client socket pooling, connection requests, and socket lifecycle within Chromium's networking stack.

classes.name: ConnectJobDelegate
classes.description: Handles delegate callbacks for connect jobs associated with the socket pool.

classes.name: StalledRequest
classes.description: Stores parameters for stalled socket requests to be retried later.

methods.name: UnlockEndpoint
methods.description: Allows another connection to the same endpoint after a WebSocket handshake.

methods.name: RequestSocket
methods.description: Requests a single socket for a given group and parameters.

methods.name: RequestSockets
methods.description: Requests multiple sockets for a group.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority for socket requests in a group.

methods.name: ReleaseSocket
methods.description: Releases a socket back to the pool.

methods.name: FlushWithError
methods.description: Flushes all sockets with an error code.

methods.name: CloseIdleSocketsInGroup
methods.description: Closes idle sockets within a specific group.

methods.name: IdleSocketCount
methods.description: Returns total number of idle sockets.

methods.name: IdleSocketCountInGroup
methods.description: Returns number of idle sockets in a specific group.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns the load state of a socket or group.

methods.name: GetInfoAsValue
methods.description: Returns socket pool info as a JSON value.

methods.name: HasActiveSocket
methods.description: Checks if a group has active sockets.

methods.name: IsStalled
methods.description: Checks if the pool is stalled.
